name: townofus-db-snapshot
description: Weekly D1 snapshot Worker. Uses the dependencies installed at the repo root (npm ci there), except wrangler, which is pinned below.

scripts.types: npx --yes wrangler@4.157.0 types worker-configuration.d.ts --config wrangler.toml --env production --env-interface SnapshotEnv --include-runtime=false --strict-vars=false
scripts.types:check: npx --yes wrangler@4.157.0 types worker-configuration.d.ts --config wrangler.toml --env production --env-interface SnapshotEnv --include-runtime=false --strict-vars=false --check
scripts.dry-run: npx --yes wrangler@4.157.0 deploy --dry-run --env staging --outdir .wrangler/dry-run && npx --yes wrangler@4.157.0 deploy --dry-run --env production --outdir .wrangler/dry-run
